title: The drone
summary: R.E.P.O. ships a drone the crew can deploy: it carries its own list of things to aim at, covering valuables, players, enemies and ordinary objects, and runs itself from state to state.
body: The drone is an item in its own right. It has behaviour and states of its own rather than being a reskinned tool, which is why deploying one is a decision rather than a throw.
It knows what it is looking for. The game gives the drone separate targeting for valuables, players, enemies and ordinary objects, which is why one can be pointed at a kind of thing and not another.
It draws its own line. The drone keeps a line between two points, which is how it shows what it is working on instead of leaving you to guess.
It runs on a battery. The drone carries a battery drain setting along with a slippery material of its own, so it works for a while and then stops rather than going forever.
It has a sound for every step. Starting, ending, deploying, retracting and its idle loop each have their own sound, so the drone tells you where it is in its routine.
The list of sounds is wider than the routine. It also names a beam loop, so the noise of a drone working is kept apart from the noises of it being moved about.
It can be aimed at a player. Because players are on the targeting list, a drone is not only a tool for the loot, which is why the crew should agree before one goes out.
What this entry does not tell you: how long a battery lasts, what a drone costs, or what it can carry. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The drone is an item with behaviour of its own.
It has separate targeting for valuables, players, enemies and ordinary objects.
It draws a line between two points.
The build names the drone's deployment and its beam loop, and ships its own icons for a battery charge, a magnet and zero gravity.
facts.evidence: asset names: Drone Deploy, Drone Beam Loop, Drone Icon - Battery Charge, Drone Icon - Magnet, Drone Icon - Zero Gravity

facts.claim: It runs on a battery and has an icon of its own.
Each stage of its use has its own sound.
It has a teleport effect of its own.
Its sounds also name an end, a retract, an idle loop and a beam loop.
The build names the drone's parts as well, including a base, a boot, a close state and an emission.
facts.evidence: asset names: Drone Base, Drone Boot, Drone Close, Drone Emission
